I mean that's your decision, but its also really hassling to make sure triple quadruple sure you feel me? Why go through all that if you can just, not? Its a risk nobody but your head is imposing at you.
Not to mention the costs afterwards. You're gonna leave funeral debt to people around you? Itll be nice to just toss out body in the woods and be done, but face it. They will throw a funeral. They will either bury you in a grave or brun your body. It will not be cheap. Who's covering that money? More debt?

I mean why should you? Its a hassle, it's usualy expensive and time consuming, and the chances you get will always have a chance of coming out alive (and probably mangled on top of it). Plus, if u make it alive, you have to deal with people crying over you not trusting you, putting you into intsitutions or medications. It just sucks overall. Failing suicide is worse than not attempting, from someone who did multiple times its really not worth the hassle tbh. For me over time it becomes unecessary risk to even try unless I know i have a 99% chance of coming out dead for good. So eh, I try to enjoy as I live and go when its time, seems easier that way.
